summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.21/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.21 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 30, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 1¢ higher than a week ago, 8¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.56 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.93) and the highest in Stevens Point ($4.49).
